VERDICT goal: the source node's goal is "End a stopped run's whole process tree so its discard succeeds", and the two commits gained since the prior review (617640075e, a1a263e3ee) leave that behaviour intact while making the SIGKILL escalation unconditional at reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:2247-2272, so no environment can reinstate the defeated SIGTERM-only stop.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when at the source run's prompt.txt:112 asks that tests/test_stop_reaps_run_tree.py end both wrapper processes, print their pids, let the following discard succeed, leave a bystander alive, and go red when the escalation is dropped; tests/test_stop_reaps_run_tree.py:137-200 asserts each clause and negative-control-escalation-dropped.log records "1 failed, 1 passed" EXIT=1.
VERDICT write_paths: the source node declared five paths (reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py, reckon/crew/process_signal.py, tests/test_stop_reaps_run_tree.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/end-a-stopped-runs-whole-process-tree-so-its-discard.html, and a figures directory); git diff --stat d460f824ec..a1a263e3ee touches only dispatch_sessions.py (18 deletions), the test (7/5) and the fragment (7/3), all inside that set, and the reviewed increment adds no path outside it.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records status complete, states at checkpoint line 6 that the switch was removed and the section tests and control rerun, the gate command at line 11, and after_suite at line 16 naming revision f9dc1666a4 with the same single pre-existing failure id as baseline_suite, both arms ending EXIT=1.
